title: Modal fe’llarning ilg‘or ma’nolari
goal_uz: Dars oxirida o‘tmish haqida aniq xulosa chiqarasiz (must have, can’t have, might have), tanqid va afsusni ifodalaysiz (should have, could have), rasmiy shall va needn’t ni to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz hamda o‘xshash modallar orasidagi nozik farqni ajratasiz.

scenes.title: Modallarning yashirin qatlami
board: Advanced meanings of modal verbs
(Modal fe’llarning ilg‘or ma’nolari)
deduction · regret · formality · nuance
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda idiomalarni tabiiy va me’yorida ishlatishni o‘rgandik. Bugun grammatikaga qaytamiz: modal fe’llarning ilg‘or ma’nolari. Dars oxirida o‘tmish haqida aniq xulosa chiqarasiz, tanqid va afsusni ifodalaysiz, rasmiy shall va needn’t ni ishlatasiz va o‘xshash modallarni bir-biridan ajratasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we worked on idioms. Today, modal verbs at a deeper level: deduction, regret, formality and nuance.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar idiomalar ustida ishladik. Bugun modal fe’llar chuqurroq: xulosa, afsus, rasmiylik va nozik farqlar.

scenes.title: Asosiy formula
board: modal + have + past participle
must have gone · should have told
can’t have seen · needn’t have come
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsning deyarli hammasi bitta formula atrofida aylanadi: modal, keyin have, keyin fe’lning uchinchi shakli. Must have gone, should have told, can’t have seen. Bu yerda have hech qachon o‘zgarmaydi, has yoki had bo‘lmaydi, chunki modaldan keyin doim fe’lning oddiy shakli keladi. Bu qolip o‘tmishga qarab xulosa, tanqid yoki afsus bildiradi.
scenes.say: Most of today's lesson rests on one pattern: modal plus have plus past participle. Must have gone. Should have told. Can't have seen. And have never changes to has or had.
scenes.say_uz: Bugungi darsning ko‘p qismi bitta qolipga tayanadi: modal, have va uchinchi shakl. Must have gone. Should have told. Can’t have seen. Have hech qachon has yoki had ga o‘zgarmaydi.

scenes.title: Aniq xulosa: must have / can’t have
board: must have done (95%: …gan bo‘lsa kerak)
can’t have / couldn’t have done (95%: bo‘lishi mumkin emas)
evidence → conclusion
scenes.say_native: Birinchi mavzu: o‘tmish haqida mantiqiy xulosa. Dalilga qarab deyarli ishonch bilan “ha” desangiz, must have ishlatiladi: the ground is wet, it must have rained. Deyarli ishonch bilan “yo‘q” desangiz, can’t have yoki couldn’t have: she can’t have seen us, she was asleep. E’tibor bering, bu yerda must ning inkori mustn’t emas, can’t. Bu juda muhim farq.
scenes.say: When the evidence makes you almost certain, use must have. The ground is wet; it must have rained. For the negative, use can't have: she can't have seen us; she was asleep.
scenes.say_uz: Dalil sizni deyarli ishontirsa, must have ishlating. Yer ho‘l, yomg‘ir yoqqan bo‘lsa kerak. Inkor uchun can’t have: u bizni ko‘rgan bo‘lishi mumkin emas, u uxlab yotgan edi.

scenes.title: Dalildan xulosaga
board: The lights are off. They must have left.
He can’t have finished already. He only started at ten.
You must have been exhausted after the flight.

examples.t: The lights are off. They must have left.
examples.uz: Chiroqlar o‘chiq. Ular ketgan bo‘lsa kerak.

examples.t: He can’t have finished already; he only started at ten.
examples.uz: U allaqachon tugatgan bo‘lishi mumkin emas, soat o‘nda endi boshlagan edi.

examples.t: You must have been exhausted after the flight.
examples.uz: Parvozdan keyin juda charchagan bo‘lsangiz kerak.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi misolga e’tibor bering: you must have been exhausted. Bu hamdardlik bildirishning juda tabiiy usuli. Ingliz tilida suhbatdoshning his-tuyg‘usini taxmin qilib aytish odobli hisoblanadi: that must have been difficult, you must have been so relieved. Davomiy shakl ham bor: must have been doing. She must have been waiting for hours, u soatlab kutgan bo‘lsa kerak.
scenes.say: The lights are off; they must have left. He can't have finished already; he only started at ten. You must have been exhausted after the flight.
scenes.say_uz: Chiroqlar o‘chiq, ular ketgan bo‘lsa kerak. U allaqachon tugatgan bo‘lishi mumkin emas, soat o‘nda endi boshlagan. Parvozdan keyin juda charchagan bo‘lsangiz kerak.

scenes.title: Ehtimol: may / might / could have
board: may / might / could have done (≈50%)
may not / might not have done
✗ couldn’t have ≠ might not have

examples.t: She might have missed the bus.

scenes.say_native: Ishonchingiz yarimta bo‘lsa, may have, might have yoki could have. She might have missed the bus, ehtimol avtobusga ulgurmagandir. Inkorda ehtiyot bo‘ling. Might not have, ehtimol qilmagandir: he might not have received my email. Couldn’t have esa butunlay boshqa: bo‘lishi mumkin emas. Ya’ni could have ijobiyda ehtimol, couldn’t have inkorda esa ishonchli inkor.
scenes.say: When you're unsure, use may have, might have or could have. She might have missed the bus. In the negative, might not have means perhaps not, but couldn't have means definitely not.
scenes.say_uz: Ishonchingiz komil bo‘lmasa, may have, might have yoki could have. U avtobusga ulgurmagan bo‘lishi mumkin. Inkorda might not have “ehtimol yo‘q”, couldn’t have esa “aniq yo‘q” degani.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan solishtirish
board: kelgan bo‘lsa kerak = must have come
kelgan bo‘lishi mumkin = may/might have come
kelgan bo‘lishi mumkin emas = can’t have come
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida bu ma’nolarni qo‘shimcha va yordamchi so‘zlar beradi: kelgan bo‘lsa kerak, kelgan bo‘lishi mumkin, kelgan bo‘lishi mumkin emas. Ingliz tilida esa hammasi modal va have qolipida. Muammo shundaki, o‘zbekcha “kerak” so‘zini ko‘rib, o‘quvchilar must ni har joyda ishlatadi, inkorda esa mustn’t have deb yuboradi. Rus tilini bilsangiz, должно быть ham must have ga, не может быть esa can’t have ga mos keladi.
scenes.say: Uzbek expresses these meanings with endings and helper words. English uses one pattern for all of them: modal plus have plus past participle.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zbek tili bu ma’nolarni qo‘shimchalar va yordamchi so‘zlar bilan ifodalaydi. Ingliz tili esa hammasi uchun bitta qolipdan foydalanadi: modal, have va uchinchi shakl.

scenes.title: Xulosa xatolari
board: ✗ He mustn’t have seen it. → ✓ He can’t have seen it.
✗ She must have went. → ✓ She must have gone.
✗ They must had left. → ✓ They must have left.
✗ It can have rained. → ✓ It may/might have rained.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta tipik xato. Birinchi: mustn’t have xulosa uchun emas, can’t have. Ikkinchi: must have went emas, uchinchi shakl, must have gone. Uchinchi: must had left emas, modaldan keyin doim have. To‘rtinchi: ijobiy ehtimol uchun can have ishlatilmaydi, may have yoki might have deyiladi. Bu xatolarning ikkitasi notartibiy fe’llarni yaxshi bilmaslikdan, shuning uchun gone, seen, done kabi shakllarni takrorlab turing.
scenes.say: He can't have seen it, not mustn't have. She must have gone, not went. They must have left, never must had. And for possibility, it might have rained, not can have.
scenes.say_uz: He can’t have seen it, mustn’t have emas. She must have gone, went emas. They must have left, hech qachon must had emas. Ehtimol uchun it might have rained, can have emas.

scenes.title: Xulosa chiqaring
board: 1) His car is outside. He ___ (arrive).
2) She was in Paris. She ___ (be) at the party.
3) I’m not sure where Tom is. He ___ (go) home.
4) The window is broken. Someone ___ (throw) a ball.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta vaziyat. Dalilga qarab must have, can’t have yoki might have bilan gap tuzing. Birinchi: mashinasi tashqarida, arrive. Ikkinchi: u Parijda edi, be at the party. Uchinchi: Tom qayerdaligini bilmayman, go home. To‘rtinchi: deraza singan, throw a ball. Avval ishonch darajasini aniqlang, keyin modalni tanlang.
scenes.say: Make deductions. His car is outside. She was in Paris during the party. I'm not sure where Tom is. The window is broken.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa chiqaring. Uning mashinasi tashqarida. Ziyofat paytida u Parijda edi. Tom qayerdaligini bilmayman. Deraza singan.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) He must have arrived.
2) She can’t have been at the party.
3) He might have gone home.
4) Someone must have thrown a ball.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: he must have arrived, dalil kuchli. Ikkinchi: she can’t have been at the party, chunki u Parijda edi. Uchinchi: he might have gone home, ishonch yo‘q, may yoki could ham to‘g‘ri. To‘rtinchi: someone must have thrown a ball, lekin agar dalil kam deb hisoblasangiz, might have ham qabul qilinadi. Thrown shaklini to‘g‘ri aytdingizmi?
scenes.say: He must have arrived. She can't have been at the party. He might have gone home. Someone must have thrown a ball.
scenes.say_uz: U kelgan bo‘lsa kerak. U ziyofatda bo‘lgan bo‘lishi mumkin emas. U uyga ketgan bo‘lishi mumkin. Kimdir to‘p otgan bo‘lsa kerak.

scenes.title: Tanqid va afsus: should have
board: should have done = it was right, but you didn’t
shouldn’t have done = it was wrong, but you did
ought to have done (more formal)
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi mavzu: tanqid va afsus. Should have done, to‘g‘ri ish edi, lekin qilinmadi: you should have told me, menga aytishing kerak edi. Shouldn’t have done, noto‘g‘ri ish edi, lekin qilindi: I shouldn’t have eaten so much. O‘zingiz haqida gapirsangiz afsus, boshqalar haqida tanqid. Ought to have done ham xuddi shu ma’noda, lekin rasmiyroq va kamroq ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Should have means it was the right thing, but it didn't happen: you should have told me. Shouldn't have means it happened, but it was wrong: I shouldn't have eaten so much.
scenes.say_uz: Should have to‘g‘ri ish edi, lekin bo‘lmadi degani: menga aytishing kerak edi. Shouldn’t have bo‘ldi, lekin noto‘g‘ri edi degani: shuncha ko‘p yemasligim kerak edi.

scenes.title: Afsus va tanqid gapda
board: I should have listened to you.
You shouldn’t have spoken to her like that.
We ought to have booked earlier.

examples.t: I should have listened to you.
You shouldn’t have spoken to her like that.
examples.uz: U bilan bunday gaplashmasligingiz kerak edi.

examples.t: We ought to have booked earlier.

scenes.say_native: Ohangga e’tibor bering. I should have listened to you, samimiy afsus, ko‘pincha kechirim bilan birga keladi. You shouldn’t have spoken to her like that, ochiq tanqid, shuning uchun uni yumshatish mumkin: maybe you shouldn’t have. Qiziq holat: kimdir sovg‘a bersa, oh, you shouldn’t have! deymiz. Bu tanqid emas, “ovora bo‘libsiz-da” degan minnatdorchilik.
scenes.say: I should have listened to you. You shouldn't have spoken to her like that. We ought to have booked earlier. And when someone gives you a present: oh, you shouldn't have!
scenes.say_uz: Sizga quloq solishim kerak edi. U bilan bunday gaplashmasligingiz kerak edi. Oldinroq bron qilishimiz kerak edi. Kimdir sovg‘a bersa: voy, ovora bo‘libsiz-da!

scenes.title: Could have va might have: ta’na
board: could have done = possible, but didn’t happen
You could have told me! (ta’na)
You might have warned me! (BrE, ta’na)
He could have been killed. (xavf o‘tib ketdi)
scenes.say_native: Could have ning yana bir ma’nosi: imkon bor edi, lekin amalga oshmadi. I could have become a doctor, shifokor bo‘lishim mumkin edi. Ikkinchi shaxs bilan esa ta’na: you could have told me! Britaniyada you might have warned me! ham shu ma’noda. Uchinchi ma’no: xavf bor edi, lekin yuz bermadi: he could have been killed. Kontekst qaysi ma’no ekanini ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Could have can mean a possibility that never happened: I could have become a doctor. With you, it's a reproach: you could have told me! And he could have been killed means he wasn't, luckily.
scenes.say_uz: Could have amalga oshmagan imkoniyatni bildirishi mumkin: shifokor bo‘lishim mumkin edi. You bilan esa ta’na: menga aytsang bo‘lardi-ku! He could have been killed esa u omon qoldi degani.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha “kerak edi” tuzog‘i
board: aytishing kerak edi = you should have told me
had to tell = majbur bo‘lib aytdi (va aytdi!)
aytsang bo‘lardi = you could have told me
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek o‘quvchilarining eng katta tuzog‘i: “aytishing kerak edi” ni you had to tell me deb tarjima qilish. Had to esa majbur bo‘lib qilinganini, ya’ni ish bajarilganini bildiradi: I had to tell him, unga aytishga majbur bo‘ldim, va aytdim. Ta’na va afsus uchun faqat should have. “Aytsang bo‘lardi-ku” esa could have: you could have told me. Bu farqni bilish gapingiz ma’nosini butunlay o‘zgartiradi.
scenes.say: I had to tell him means I was obliged, and I did. You should have told me means you didn't, and that was wrong. Very different meanings.
scenes.say_uz: I had to tell him majbur bo‘ldim va aytdim degani. You should have told me esa aytmading va bu noto‘g‘ri edi degani. Ma’nolar butunlay boshqa.

scenes.title: Tanqid xatolari
board: ✗ You had to call me! → ✓ You should have called me!
✗ You must have called me! (reproach) → ✓ should have
✗ I should told her. → ✓ I should have told her.
✗ should of → ✓ should have / should’ve
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta xato. Birinchi: you had to call me ta’na emas, shuning uchun you should have called me. Ikkinchi: you must have called me xulosa, ya’ni “qo‘ng‘iroq qilgan bo‘lsang kerak”, ta’na emas. Uchinchi: have tushib qolmasin, should have told. To‘rtinchi: should of yozuvda xato, u faqat should’ve ning eshitilishiga o‘xshaydi. Hatto ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ham shu xatoni qiladi, lekin u baribir xato.
scenes.say: You should have called me, not had to, and not must have. I should have told her, with have. And never write should of; write should have or should've.
scenes.say_uz: You should have called me, had to emas, must have ham emas. I should have told her, have bilan. Hech qachon should of yozmang; should have yoki should’ve yozing.

scenes.title: Ta’na yoki afsus bildiring
board: 1) You didn’t revise. You failed. (I)
2) Your friend didn’t tell you about the party. (You)
3) You shouted at your brother. (I)
4) He drove fast; luckily, no accident. (could)
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta vaziyat, har biriga bitta gap. Birinchi: takrorlamadingiz va yiqildingiz, I bilan afsus. Ikkinchi: do‘stingiz ziyofat haqida aytmadi, you bilan ta’na. Uchinchi: ukangizga baqirdingiz, I bilan afsus. To‘rtinchi: u tez haydadi, baxtiga avariya bo‘lmadi, could bilan. Har biriga mos modalni va to‘g‘ri uchinchi shaklni tanlang.
scenes.say: Respond with a modal. You didn't revise and failed. Your friend didn't mention the party. You shouted at your brother. He drove too fast, but luckily nothing happened.
scenes.say_uz: Modal bilan javob bering. Takrorlamadingiz va yiqildingiz. Do‘stingiz ziyofat haqida aytmadi. Ukangizga baqirdingiz. U juda tez haydadi, baxtiga hech narsa bo‘lmadi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I should have revised.
2) You could have / should have told me!
3) I shouldn’t have shouted at him.
4) He could have had an accident.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: I should have revised. Ikkinchi: you should have told me yoki ta’na kuchliroq bo‘lsin desangiz, you could have told me! Uchinchi: I shouldn’t have shouted at him, inkor bilan afsus. To‘rtinchi: he could have had an accident yoki he could have been killed. Agar uchinchi gapda I should not shout deb aytgan bo‘lsangiz, have va uchinchi shaklni unutmang.
scenes.say: I should have revised. You could have told me! I shouldn't have shouted at him. He could have had an accident.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlashim kerak edi. Menga aytsang bo‘lardi-ku! Unga baqirmasligim kerak edi. U avariyaga uchrashi mumkin edi.

scenes.title: Tinglash: aeroportda
board: Listen: Aziz and Kate missed their flight
Q1 Why does Kate think they missed it?
Q2 What does Aziz regret?
Q3 Where might the passports be?
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash. Aziz va Keyt aeroportda, parvozga ulgurmay qolishdi. Uch savol. Birinchi: Keyt nima uchun ulgurmadik deb o‘ylaydi? Ikkinchi: Aziz nimadan afsuslanadi? Uchinchi: pasportlar qayerda bo‘lishi mumkin? Bugungi barcha qoliplarni eshitasiz: xulosa, afsus va ta’na.
scenes.say: Kate: The gate must have closed ten minutes ago. Aziz: I should have checked the time. Kate: You could have told me the traffic was that bad! Aziz: Sorry. And where are the passports? Kate: I might have left them in the taxi. No, wait, they can't have fallen out. Here they are.
scenes.say_uz: Keyt: Darvoza o‘n daqiqa oldin yopilgan bo‘lsa kerak. Aziz: Vaqtni tekshirishim kerak edi. Keyt: Tirbandlik shunchalik yomonligini aytsang bo‘lardi-ku! Aziz: Kechir. Pasportlar qani? Keyt: Taksida qoldirgan bo‘lishim mumkin. Yo‘q, to‘xta, ular tushib qolgan bo‘lishi mumkin emas. Mana ular.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: Q1 When did the gate close, according to Kate?
Q2 What does Aziz regret?
Q3 Where does Kate think the passports might be?
Q4 Where are they in the end?
scenes.say_native: Javob bering. Birinchi: Keytning fikricha, darvoza qachon yopilgan? Ikkinchi: Aziz nimadan afsuslanadi? Uchinchi: Keyt pasportlarni qayerda qoldirgan bo‘lishi mumkin deb o‘ylaydi? To‘rtinchi: oxirida ular qayerda chiqadi? Javobda modal qolipni takrorlashga harakat qiling, masalan: she thinks the gate must have closed ten minutes ago.
scenes.say: When did the gate close? What does Aziz regret? Where might the passports be? And where are they in the end?
scenes.say_uz: Darvoza qachon yopilgan? Aziz nimadan afsuslanadi? Pasportlar qayerda bo‘lishi mumkin? Oxirida ular qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) It must have closed ten minutes ago.
2) He should have checked the time.
3) She might have left them in the taxi.
4) With them: they can’t have fallen out.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Keyt darvoza o‘n daqiqa oldin yopilgan bo‘lsa kerak, deydi, must have closed. Ikkinchi: Aziz vaqtni tekshirmaganidan afsuslanadi, should have checked. Uchinchi: Keyt pasportlarni taksida qoldirgan bo‘lishi mumkin deb o‘ylaydi, might have left. To‘rtinchi: pasportlar ularning yonida, Keyt o‘zini tuzatadi: they can’t have fallen out. Bitta qisqa suhbatda to‘rtta qolip.
scenes.say: The gate must have closed ten minutes ago. Aziz should have checked the time. Kate might have left the passports in the taxi, but no, they're with her.
scenes.say_uz: Darvoza o‘n daqiqa oldin yopilgan bo‘lsa kerak. Aziz vaqtni tekshirishi kerak edi. Keyt pasportlarni taksida qoldirgan bo‘lishi mumkin edi, lekin yo‘q, ular uning yonida.

scenes.title: Rasmiy shall
board: Shall I open the window? (taklif, BrE)
Shall we go? (taklif)
The tenant shall pay the rent monthly. (huquqiy majburiyat)
Will you…? (savol) ✗ Shall you…?
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: rasmiy modallar. Shall bugun ikki joyda yashaydi. Birinchisi, I va we bilan taklif va maslahat so‘rash: shall I open the window? Shall we go? Bu ayniqsa britancha. Ikkinchisi, huquqiy hujjatlar: the tenant shall pay the rent monthly, bu majburiyat. Oddiy kelasi zamon uchun shall bugun kam ishlatiladi, “Shall you come?” esa eskicha, will you ishlating.
scenes.say: Shall survives in two places. Offers and suggestions: shall I open the window? Shall we go? And legal documents, where it expresses obligation: the tenant shall pay the rent monthly.
scenes.say_uz: Shall ikki joyda saqlanib qolgan. Taklif va maslahatda: derazani ochaymi? Ketdikmi? Va huquqiy hujjatlarda, majburiyat ma’nosida: ijarachi ijara haqini har oy to‘laydi.

scenes.title: Shartnoma tili
board: The Employee shall give one month’s notice.
The Company shall not be liable for…
Payment shall be made within 30 days.

examples.t: The Employee shall give one month’s notice.
examples.uz: Xodim bir oy oldin ogohlantirishi shart.

examples.t: Payment shall be made within 30 days.
examples.uz: To‘lov 30 kun ichida amalga oshirilishi shart.

scenes.say_native: Shartnomalarda shall “shart”, “majbur” degan qat’iy ma’noni beradi. The Company shall not be liable, kompaniya javobgar bo‘lmaydi. Payment shall be made within thirty days, to‘lov o‘ttiz kun ichida amalga oshirilishi shart. O‘zbekcha rasmiy hujjatlarda bu ko‘pincha “-adi” yoki “shart” bilan beriladi. Bunday hujjatlarni o‘qiganda shall ni kelasi zamon deb emas, majburiyat deb tushuning.
scenes.say: The Employee shall give one month's notice. The Company shall not be liable for any loss. Payment shall be made within thirty days.
scenes.say_uz: Xodim bir oy oldin ogohlantirishi shart. Kompaniya hech qanday zarar uchun javobgar bo‘lmaydi. To‘lov o‘ttiz kun ichida amalga oshirilishi shart.

scenes.title: Need not: rasmiy “shart emas”
board: You needn’t worry. (BrE, formal)
= You don’t need to worry.
needn’t + bare infinitive (✗ needn’t to)
Need I say more?
scenes.say_native: Need modal sifatida ham ishlatiladi, asosan inkor va savolda va ko‘proq britancha. You needn’t worry, xavotir olishingiz shart emas. Bu you don’t need to worry bilan bir xil ma’noda, lekin biroz rasmiyroq. Modal need dan keyin to bo‘lmaydi: needn’t worry, needn’t to worry emas. Savolda: need I say more? Yana gapirishim shartmi? Amerikada odatda don’t need to va do I need to ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: Need can behave like a modal in negatives and questions, especially in British English. You needn't worry. Need I say more? No to after needn't.
scenes.say_uz: Need inkor va savollarda modal kabi ishlashi mumkin, ayniqsa britancha. Xavotir olishingiz shart emas. Yana gapirishim shartmi? Needn’t dan keyin to yo‘q.

scenes.title: Needn’t have vs didn’t need to
board: needn’t have done = did it, but it wasn’t necessary
didn’t need to do = it wasn’t necessary (usually not done)
I needn’t have cooked. (pishirdim, behuda)
I didn’t need to cook. (pishirish shart emas edi)
scenes.say_native: Endi eng nozik juftlik. I needn’t have cooked: ovqat pishirdim, lekin bu keraksiz bo‘lib chiqdi, mehmonlar ovqatlanib kelishgan ekan. I didn’t need to cook: pishirish shart emas edi, odatda men pishirmadim ham. O‘zbekcha: “pishirmasam ham bo‘lar ekan” needn’t have, “pishirishim shart emas edi” esa didn’t need to. Birinchisida ish bajarilgan va behuda, ikkinchisida odatda bajarilmagan.
scenes.say: I needn't have cooked means I cooked, but it was unnecessary. I didn't need to cook usually means it wasn't necessary, so I didn't.
scenes.say_uz: I needn’t have cooked pishirdim, lekin bu keraksiz edi degani. I didn’t need to cook odatda shart emas edi, shuning uchun pishirmadim degani.

scenes.title: Behuda ish
board: We needn’t have hurried; the train was late.
I didn’t need to take a taxi; Ali gave me a lift.
You needn’t have bought me flowers!

examples.t: We needn’t have hurried; the train was late.
examples.uz: Shoshilmasak ham bo‘lar ekan, poyezd kechikdi.

examples.t: I didn’t need to take a taxi; Ali gave me a lift.
examples.uz: Taksi olishim shart emas edi, Ali meni olib bordi.

scenes.say_native: Misollarni tahlil qilamiz. We needn’t have hurried: biz shoshildik, lekin poyezd kechikdi, shoshilish behuda edi. I didn’t need to take a taxi: taksi shart emas edi, chunki Ali olib bordi, demak taksi olmadim. You needn’t have bought me flowers, sovg‘a olganda aytiladigan iliq gap: ovora bo‘libsiz. Bu oldin ko‘rgan you shouldn’t have! ga juda yaqin.
scenes.say: We needn't have hurried; the train was late. I didn't need to take a taxi; Ali gave me a lift. You needn't have bought me flowers!
scenes.say_uz: Shoshilmasak ham bo‘lar ekan, poyezd kechikdi. Taksi olishim shart emas edi, Ali meni olib bordi. Menga gul olib ovora bo‘lmasangiz ham bo‘lardi!

scenes.title: Rasmiy modal xatolari
board: ✗ You needn’t to come. → ✓ You needn’t come.
✗ I needn’t have gone. (I didn’t go) → ✓ I didn’t need to go.
✗ Shall you be there? → ✓ Will you be there?
✗ The tenant will pay… (contract) → ✓ shall pay
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchi: needn’t to come emas, needn’t come. Ikkinchi: agar umuman bormagan bo‘lsangiz, I needn’t have gone deyilmaydi, chunki needn’t have borgansiz degani; to‘g‘risi, I didn’t need to go. Uchinchi: shall you be there eskicha, will you be there. To‘rtinchi: rasmiy shartnoma yozayotgan bo‘lsangiz, majburiyat uchun an’anaviy ravishda shall ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: You needn't come, without to. If you didn't go, say I didn't need to go. Ask will you be there, not shall you. And in a formal contract, the tenant shall pay.
scenes.say_uz: You needn’t come, to siz. Bormagan bo‘lsangiz, I didn’t need to go deng. Will you be there deb so‘rang, shall you emas. Rasmiy shartnomada esa the tenant shall pay.

scenes.title: Needn’t have yoki didn’t need to?
board: 1) I took an umbrella, but it didn’t rain. I ___ (take) it.
2) It was a holiday, so I ___ (get up) early. I slept till ten.
3) She revised all night, but the exam was cancelled. She ___ (revise).
4) Formal offer: ___ I open the window?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Birinchi: soyabon oldim, lekin yomg‘ir yog‘madi. Ikkinchi: bayram edi, shuning uchun erta turish shart emas edi, o‘ngacha uxladim. Uchinchi: u tun bo‘yi takrorladi, lekin imtihon bekor qilindi. To‘rtinchi: rasmiy taklif, derazani ochaymi? Har birida ish bajarilganmi yoki yo‘qmi, avval shuni aniqlang.
scenes.say: Needn't have or didn't need to? An umbrella, but no rain. A holiday, so I slept till ten. She revised all night; the exam was cancelled. And: blank I open the window?
scenes.say_uz: Needn’t have yoki didn’t need to? Soyabon, lekin yomg‘ir yo‘q. Bayram, shuning uchun o‘ngacha uxladim. U tun bo‘yi takrorladi, imtihon bekor bo‘ldi. Va: ... derazani ochaymi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I needn’t have taken it.
2) I didn’t need to get up early.
3) She needn’t have revised.
4) Shall I open the window?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: I needn’t have taken it, soyabonni oldim, lekin keraksiz bo‘ldi. Ikkinchi: I didn’t need to get up early, erta turmadim. Uchinchi: she needn’t have revised, takrorladi, lekin behuda. Agar uchinchida “she didn’t need to revise” desangiz, grammatik xato emas, lekin “takrorladi” degan ma’no yo‘qoladi. To‘rtinchi: shall I open the window?
scenes.say: I needn't have taken it. I didn't need to get up early. She needn't have revised. Shall I open the window?
scenes.say_uz: Uni olmasam ham bo‘lar ekan. Erta turishim shart emas edi. U takrorlamasa ham bo‘lar ekan. Derazani ochaymi?

scenes.title: Nozik farq: may, might, could, can
board: It may rain. (formal) · It might rain. (less sure)
It could rain tomorrow. (specific)
It can be cold here in winter. (general truth)
✗ It can rain tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: nozik ma’no farqlari. Hozirgi ehtimolda may va might deyarli bir xil, lekin may biroz rasmiyroq, might esa biroz ishonchsizroq eshitiladi. Could aniq vaziyat haqida: it could rain tomorrow. Can esa umumiy haqiqat haqida: it can be cold here in winter, bu yerda qishda sovuq bo‘lib turadi. Shuning uchun it can rain tomorrow g‘alati: aniq kelajak uchun can emas, could, may yoki might.
scenes.say: It may rain sounds slightly more formal; it might rain, slightly less certain. It could rain tomorrow is about a specific case. But it can be cold here in winter is a general truth.
scenes.say_uz: It may rain biroz rasmiyroq, it might rain biroz ishonchsizroq eshitiladi. It could rain tomorrow aniq holat haqida. It can be cold here in winter esa umumiy haqiqat.

scenes.title: Must va have to; mustn’t va don’t have to
board: I must call Mum. (o‘zim xohlayman)
I have to wear a uniform. (qoida)
You mustn’t smoke here. (taqiq)
You don’t have to come. (shart emas)
scenes.say_native: Britaniya inglizchasida must ko‘pincha so‘zlovchining o‘z fikrini bildiradi: I must call Mum, o‘zim zarur deb bilaman. Have to esa tashqi qoida: I have to wear a uniform. Inkorda farq juda katta: you mustn’t smoke here, chekish taqiqlangan. You don’t have to come, kelish shart emas, xohlasangiz kelasiz. O‘zbekcha “shart emas” va “mumkin emas” ni adashtirmang.
scenes.say: I must call Mum is my own feeling; I have to wear a uniform is a rule. And the negatives are opposites: you mustn't smoke here means it's forbidden; you don't have to come means it's optional.
scenes.say_uz: I must call Mum o‘z hissim; I have to wear a uniform qoida. Inkorlari esa qarama-qarshi: you mustn’t smoke here taqiq; you don’t have to come esa ixtiyoriy degani.

scenes.title: Will va would: odat va xarakter
board: She will talk for hours. (xarakterli odat)
He WILL keep interrupting! (zerikarli odat, urg‘u)
He wouldn’t listen. (o‘tmishda ko‘nmadi)
The door won’t open. (narsa ham “ko‘nmaydi”)
scenes.say_native: Will va would faqat kelasi zamon emas. Will xarakterli odatni bildiradi: she will talk for hours if you let her. Urg‘u bilan aytilsa, zerikarli odat: he WILL keep interrupting! Would not o‘tmishdagi qat’iy rad etish: I asked him, but he wouldn’t listen, quloq solmadi. Hatto narsalar ham shunday “ko‘nmaydi”: the door won’t open, eshik ochilmayapti.
scenes.say: Will can describe typical behaviour: she'll talk for hours if you let her. Stressed, it shows irritation: he will keep interrupting! Wouldn't means refused: he wouldn't listen. And the door won't open.
scenes.say_uz: Will odatiy xulqni bildirishi mumkin: imkon bersangiz, u soatlab gapiradi. Urg‘u bilan esa norozilik: u gapni bo‘laverishini qo‘ymaydi! Wouldn’t rad etdi degani: u quloq solmadi. Eshik esa ochilmayapti.

scenes.title: Could va was able to
board: She could swim at five. (umumiy qobiliyat)
She was able to / managed to swim to the shore. (bir martalik)
✓ I couldn’t open it. (inkor — ikkalasi ham)
✓ I could see the sea. (sezgi fe’llari)
scenes.say_native: O‘tmishdagi qobiliyatda ham nozik farq bor. Umumiy qobiliyat: she could swim at five, besh yoshida suzishni bilardi. Lekin bir martalik aniq muvaffaqiyat uchun could emas, was able to yoki managed to: she was able to swim to the shore. Inkorda esa ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri: I couldn’t open it. See, hear kabi sezgi fe’llari bilan could ham bir martalik holatda ishlatiladi: I could see the sea.
scenes.say: For general ability, use could: she could swim at five. For one specific success, use was able to or managed to: she was able to swim to the shore. In the negative, couldn't is fine.
scenes.say_uz: Umumiy qobiliyat uchun could: besh yoshida suza olardi. Bitta aniq muvaffaqiyat uchun was able to yoki managed to: qirg‘oqqacha suzib bora oldi. Inkorda couldn’t to‘g‘ri.

scenes.title: Nozik farq xatolari
board: ✗ You mustn’t come if you’re busy. → ✓ You don’t have to come.
✗ After hours, I could fix it. → ✓ I managed to fix it.
✗ It can snow tomorrow. → ✓ It might snow tomorrow.
✗ He didn’t want to listen. (≈ refused) → ✓ He wouldn’t listen.
scenes.say_native: Xatolar. Birinchi: band bo‘lsangiz kelish shart emas, demoqchi bo‘lsangiz, mustn’t emas, don’t have to. Aks holda “kelishingiz taqiqlanadi” bo‘lib chiqadi. Ikkinchi: bir necha soatdan keyin tuzatdim, bu bitta muvaffaqiyat, shuning uchun managed to yoki was able to. Uchinchi: aniq ertangi kun uchun can emas, might. To‘rtinchi: rad etishni he wouldn’t listen juda tabiiy ifodalaydi.
scenes.say: You don't have to come if you're busy, not mustn't. After hours, I managed to fix it. It might snow tomorrow. And he wouldn't listen.
scenes.say_uz: Band bo‘lsangiz, kelishingiz shart emas, mustn’t emas. Bir necha soatdan keyin tuzata oldim. Ertaga qor yog‘ishi mumkin. U esa quloq solmadi.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri modalni tanlang
board: 1) You (mustn’t / don’t have to) pay; it’s free.
2) The fire spread, but everyone (could / was able to) escape.
3) I begged her, but she (wouldn’t / mustn’t) change her mind.
4) It (can / might) be windy tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap, qavs ichidagi ikki variantdan birini tanlang. Birinchi: bepul, to‘lash taqiqmi yoki shart emasmi? Ikkinchi: yong‘in tarqaldi, lekin hamma qochib qutula oldi. Uchinchi: yalindim, lekin u fikrini o‘zgartirmadi. To‘rtinchi: ertaga shamol bo‘lishi mumkin. Har birida o‘zingizga savol bering: umumiymi yoki aniq, taqiqmi yoki ixtiyoriy?
scenes.say: Choose. You mustn't or don't have to pay; it's free. Everyone could or was able to escape. She wouldn't or mustn't change her mind. It can or might be windy tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Tanlang. Bepul, to‘lash mustn’t yoki don’t have to. Hamma could yoki was able to qochdi. U fikrini wouldn’t yoki mustn’t o‘zgartirdi. Ertaga can yoki might shamol bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) don’t have to
2) was able to
3) wouldn’t
4) might
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: don’t have to, chunki bepul, to‘lash ixtiyoriy emas, balki shart emas. Ikkinchi: was able to, chunki bu bitta aniq voqea va muvaffaqiyat. Uchinchi: wouldn’t, rad etish. Mustn’t bu yerda umuman ma’no bermaydi. To‘rtinchi: might, aniq kelajak haqida ehtimol. To‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, modallarning nozik farqlarini yaxshi his qilyapsiz.
scenes.say: Don't have to. Was able to. Wouldn't. Might.
scenes.say_uz: Don’t have to. Was able to. Wouldn’t. Might.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: kuchsiz have
board: must have → must’ve /ˈmʌstəv/
should have → should’ve /ˈʃʊdəv/
couldn’t have → /ˈkʊdntəv/
✗ should of (yozuvda)
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. Og‘zaki nutqda have deyarli doim kuchsiz shaklda: əv. Must have, must’ve. Should have, should’ve. Couldn’t have, kudntəv. Urg‘u modalga yoki asosiy fe’lga tushadi, have ga emas: you SHOULD’ve TOLD me. Shuning uchun eshitganda should of ga o‘xshaydi, lekin yozuvda doim should have yoki should’ve. Siz ham have ni to‘liq aytmasangiz, nutqingiz ancha tabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say: In speech, have is weak: must've, should've, could've, couldn't've. The stress falls on the modal and the main verb: you should've told me. It sounds like of, but always write have.
scenes.say_uz: Nutqda have kuchsiz: must’ve, should’ve, could’ve, couldn’t’ve. Urg‘u modal va asosiy fe’lga tushadi: you should’ve told me. Of ga o‘xshab eshitiladi, lekin doim have yozing.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: It must’ve RAINED.
You SHOULD’ve TOLD me.
She CAN’T’ve SEEN us.
We NEEDN’T’ve HURRIED.
scenes.say_native: Men bilan birga ayting. To‘rtta gap, have ni kuchsiz əv qilib, urg‘uni modal va asosiy fe’lga qo‘yib. It must’ve rained. You should’ve told me. She can’t’ve seen us. We needn’t’ve hurried. Har birini ikki marta takrorlang. Ikkinchi marta tezroq, so‘zlarni bir-biriga ulab ayting.
scenes.say: Repeat. It must've rained. You should've told me. She can't've seen us. We needn't've hurried.
scenes.say_uz: Takrorlang. Yomg‘ir yoqqan bo‘lsa kerak. Menga aytishing kerak edi. U bizni ko‘rgan bo‘lishi mumkin emas. Shoshilmasak ham bo‘lar ekan.

scenes.title: O‘zingizni tekshiring
board: ✓ have = /əv/, never /hæv/
✓ stress: modal + main verb
✓ linking: must’ve‿rained
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. Have ni to‘liq hæv deb aytmadingizmi? Urg‘u should va told ga, can’t va seen ga tushdimi? So‘zlar bir-biriga ulanib ketdimi? Agar have ni har safar alohida, aniq aytgan bo‘lsangiz, bu o‘zbek tilidagi har bir bo‘g‘inni aniq aytish odatidan. Sekin boshlang, keyin tezlashtiring.
scenes.say: Did have shrink to /əv/? Did the stress fall on the modal and the main verb? If have sounded full and separate, slow down, then speed up gradually.
scenes.say_uz: Have /əv/ ga qisqardimi? Urg‘u modal va asosiy fe’lga tushdimi? Have to‘liq va alohida eshitilgan bo‘lsa, sekin boshlab, asta-sekin tezlashtiring.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ishdagi yig‘ilish
board: Listen: a manager and an employee
Q1 What went wrong with the report?
Q2 What does the manager offer to do?
Q3 Does Jamol need to rewrite everything?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash. Rahbar va xodim Jamol hisobot haqida gaplashadi. Uch savol. Birinchi: hisobot bilan nima noto‘g‘ri bo‘ldi? Ikkinchi: rahbar nima qilishni taklif qiladi? Uchinchi: Jamol hammasini qayta yozishi kerakmi? Rasmiy modallarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Manager: The figures in your report can't have come from the latest data. Jamol: You're right. I should have checked the date. Manager: Well, shall I send you the new file? Jamol: Yes, please. Should I rewrite the whole thing? Manager: No, you needn't. Just update the tables. Jamol: Thanks. I needn't have panicked, then.
scenes.say_uz: Rahbar: Hisobotingizdagi raqamlar oxirgi ma’lumotlardan olingan bo‘lishi mumkin emas. Jamol: To‘g‘ri. Sanani tekshirishim kerak edi. Rahbar: Xo‘sh, yangi faylni yuboraymi? Jamol: Ha, iltimos. Hammasini qayta yozaymi? Rahbar: Yo‘q, shart emas. Faqat jadvallarni yangilang. Jamol: Rahmat. Demak, behuda vahimaga tushgan ekanman.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: Q1 What was wrong with the figures?
Q2 What does the manager offer?
Q3 Must Jamol rewrite everything?
Q4 How does Jamol feel at the end?
scenes.say_native: Javob bering. Birinchi: raqamlar bilan nima noto‘g‘ri edi? Ikkinchi: rahbar nima taklif qiladi? Uchinchi: Jamol hammasini qayta yozishi shartmi? To‘rtinchi: oxirida Jamol o‘zini qanday his qiladi? Javoblaringizda modallarni ishlatishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: What was wrong with the figures? What does the manager offer? Must Jamol rewrite everything? How does he feel at the end?
scenes.say_uz: Raqamlar bilan nima noto‘g‘ri edi? Rahbar nima taklif qiladi? Jamol hammasini qayta yozishi shartmi? Oxirida u o‘zini qanday his qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) They can’t have come from the latest data.
2) Shall I send you the new file?
3) No, he needn’t; just the tables.
4) Relieved: he needn’t have panicked.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: raqamlar oxirgi ma’lumotlardan olingan bo‘lishi mumkin emas, Jamol sanani tekshirmagan. Ikkinchi: rahbar yangi faylni yuborishni taklif qiladi, shall I send. Uchinchi: yo‘q, you needn’t, faqat jadvallarni yangilash kerak. To‘rtinchi: Jamol yengil tortadi, I needn’t have panicked, ya’ni vahimaga tushdi, lekin behuda. Bitta suhbatda to‘rtala mavzu ham bor edi.
scenes.say: The figures can't have come from the latest data. The manager offers to send the new file. Jamol needn't rewrite everything. He's relieved: he needn't have panicked.
scenes.say_uz: Raqamlar oxirgi ma’lumotlardan olingan bo‘lishi mumkin emas. Rahbar yangi faylni yuborishni taklif qiladi. Jamol hammasini qayta yozishi shart emas. U yengil tortdi: vahimaga tushmasa ham bo‘lar ekan.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq
board: Talk about a day that went wrong:
1 deduction (must / can’t / might have)
1 regret (should / shouldn’t have)
1 needn’t have · 1 could have
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy og‘zaki topshiriq. Yomon o‘tgan bir kuningiz haqida qisqa gapiring. Kamida to‘rtta modal qolip ishlating: bitta xulosa, must have, can’t have yoki might have; bitta afsus, should have; bitta needn’t have; bitta could have. Have ni kuchsiz talaffuz qilishni unutmang. Yozib olib, keyin modallarni sanab chiqing.
scenes.say: Your turn. Describe a day that went wrong. Use a deduction, a regret, needn't have and could have.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizda. Yomon o‘tgan kunni tasvirlang. Xulosa, afsus, needn’t have va could have ishlating.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: My alarm must have failed…
I should have set two alarms.
I needn’t have rushed: the meeting was postponed.
I could have stayed in bed!
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javobda to‘rtala qolip bor. My alarm must have failed, xulosa. I should have set two alarms, afsus. I needn’t have rushed, shoshildim, lekin behuda, chunki yig‘ilish ko‘chirilgan ekan. I could have stayed in bed, amalga oshmagan imkoniyat va biroz hazil. Hikoya qisqa, lekin har bir modal o‘z ishini qiladi. Sizning javobingiz ham shunday aniq bo‘lsa, maqsadga erishdingiz.
scenes.say: My alarm must have failed, because I woke up at nine. I should have set two alarms. I rushed to the office, but I needn't have: the meeting was postponed. I could have stayed in bed!
scenes.say_uz: Budilnigim ishlamagan bo‘lsa kerak, chunki soat to‘qqizda uyg‘ondim. Ikkita budilnik qo‘yishim kerak edi. Ofisga shoshildim, lekin behuda: yig‘ilish ko‘chirilgan ekan. To‘shakda qolsam ham bo‘lar ekan!

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Deduction: must / might / can’t have done
Criticism & regret: should(n’t) / could have done
Formal: shall · needn’t (have)
Nuance: mustn’t ≠ don’t have to; could ≠ was able to
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Xulosa uchun must have, might have va can’t have; mustn’t have emas. Tanqid va afsus uchun should have va could have; had to emas. Rasmiy shall taklif va shartnomada, needn’t have esa bajarilgan, lekin keraksiz ish. Nozik farqlar: mustn’t taqiq, don’t have to ixtiyor; could umumiy qobiliyat, was able to bir martalik muvaffaqiyat. Talaffuzda have kuchsiz.
scenes.say: Deduction: must have, might have, can't have. Regret and criticism: should have, could have. Formal: shall and needn't. And remember: mustn't and don't have to are opposites.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: must have, might have, can’t have. Afsus va tanqid: should have, could have. Rasmiy: shall va needn’t. Eslab qoling: mustn’t va don’t have to qarama-qarshi.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Write 10 sentences with advanced modal meanings
3 deduction · 3 regret/criticism · 2 shall/needn’t · 2 nuance
Label each meaning
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Ilg‘or modal ma’nolarini ko‘rsatadigan o‘nta gap yozing: uchtasi o‘tmish haqida xulosa, uchtasi afsus yoki tanqid, ikkitasi shall yoki needn’t, ikkitasi nozik farq, masalan, don’t have to yoki was able to. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir gap yonida ma’nosi yozilgan, qolip to‘g‘ri, ya’ni modal, have va uchinchi shakl. Keyingi darsda to‘xtamasdan ikki daqiqa gapirish texnikasini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, write ten sentences showing advanced modal meanings, and label the meaning of each. Next time: how to speak for two minutes without stopping.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: ilg‘or modal ma’nolarini ko‘rsatadigan o‘nta gap yozing va har birining ma’nosini belgilang. Keyingi safar: to‘xtamasdan ikki daqiqa gapirish.

homework_uz: Ilg‘or modal ma’nolarini ko‘rsatadigan 10 ta gap yozing: 3 ta o‘tmish haqida xulosa, 3 ta afsus yoki tanqid, 2 ta shall/needn’t, 2 ta nozik farq (masalan, don’t have to, was able to). Mezon: har bir gap yonida ma’nosi yozilgan va qolip to‘g‘ri (modal + have + uchinchi shakl).

quiz.q: The ground is wet. It ___ in the night.
quiz.why_uz: O‘tmish haqida aniq xulosa: must have + uchinchi shakl.

quiz.q: She was in Paris all week. She ___ you at the market.
quiz.why_uz: Ishonchli inkor xulosa can’t have bilan, mustn’t have bilan emas.

quiz.q: Your friend didn't tell you about the change. You say: "You ___ me!"
quiz.why_uz: Ta’na should have bilan; had to bajarilgan majburiyatni bildiradi.

quiz.q: I took a coat, but it was warm. I ___ it.
quiz.why_uz: Ish bajarilgan, lekin keraksiz bo‘lgan: needn’t have done.

quiz.q: Which sentence is a polite offer?
options: Shall I carry that for you?
Will I carry that for you?
Must I carry that for you?
Need I carry that for you?
quiz.why_uz: I bilan taklif uchun Shall I…? ishlatiladi.
Shart emas = don’t have to; mustn’t taqiqni bildiradi.

quiz.q: The boat sank, but all the passengers ___ reach the shore.
quiz.why_uz: Bir martalik aniq muvaffaqiyat uchun was/were able to yoki managed to.
Modal need dan keyin to siz oddiy fe’l keladi.

quiz.q: "He could have been killed." This means…
options: he wasn't killed, but it was possible
quiz.why_uz: Could have been: xavf bor edi, lekin yuz bermadi.

quiz.q: How is "should have" usually written in informal English?
quiz.why_uz: Qisqartma should’ve; should of yozuvda xato.
